description: MainActivity class for an Android application handling notification permissions, SSH testing, and navigation to settings. It includes UI bindings, permission handling, and SSH command execution using coroutines.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Activity managing notification access, SSH testing, and navigation. Handles permissions, UI binding with coroutines, and SSH command execution.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, sets click listeners, and binds UI flows.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes UI for notification permission status.

methods.name: bindUi
methods.description: Binds preference flows to UI elements, updates last result/status timestamps.

methods.name: refreshPermissionUi
methods.description: Updates notification permission indicators and buttons.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener is enabled.

methods.name: needsPostNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Determines if POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission is needed.

methods.name: requestPostNotificationsIfNeededLegacy
methods.description: Requests POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission if needed (API >= TIRAMISU).

methods.name: openSettingsActivity
methods.description: Starts SettingsActivity, fallback to app details.

methods.name: openAppSelectionActivity
methods.description: Starts AppSelectionActivity, fallback to app details.

methods.name: launchTestSsh
methods.description: Executes an SSH command using real or fake client, updates UI based on result.
